preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n is between 2 and 30000.

preconditions.expression: -108 <= ai <= 108 for all ai in a
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence is between -108 and 108.
All elements in the sequence are different.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No solution' or two lines representing the two arithmetic progressions.
Each progression contains at least one number.
The union of the two progressions contains all elements of the original sequence.
